gate.basis: Recorded engineering acceptance agreement: 4 ms physics step, 12 ms maximum. The 12.5 ms rotor time constant is context, not proof of policy delay tolerance or stability.

capture_cost_1p0.definition: At 1.0 m/s the capture part of the C->N cost is the absolute value of the acceleration-matched 01b M1 RAPTOR baseline (zero-velocity capture with intact memory; 01b: 86% of the N0 step, 93% of the altitude loss, 99% of the tilt). Part of it removed by T1 = (T0 - T1) / baseline, T0 and T1 from batch 01c (both N2 memory), 95% bootstrap over the three groups. In-batch T0 is compared with 01b M1 N2 (same profile and memory). Cross-batch reference as requested, not an acceptance splice.

definitions.groups: speed level (V1.0..V3.0) x takeover target (T0 zero-velocity capture, T1 speed-matched with 2.0 m/s^2), N2 memory in all runs
definitions.all_runs: every run including flight failures (a failed run is measured up to the runner safety abort)
definitions.settle: first vehicle_local_position sample (timestamp_sample) after the change from which the 3D speed stays below 0.1 m/s until the window end (change + post_handover_s); settle time from the change; distance = horizontal and along-axis distance from the position at the change to the position at the settle time. None if the speed is not below the threshold at the window end or the flight failed.
definitions.clipping: research_memory inference rows while RAPTOR is active in [change, window end]: a component is clipped when |value| >= limit*(1-1e-6). Reported separately for position and velocity: rows, total duration (zero-order hold to the next row), first and last clipped time after the change, longest continuous span.
definitions.group_ci: mean and two-sided 95% t interval (Student t, n-1 dof) over the runs of one group
definitions.bootstrap: 95% percentile bootstrap, groups resampled independently, 20000 resamples, numpy default_rng(master_seed)
definitions.capture_cost: At 1.0 m/s the capture part of the C->N cost is the absolute value of the acceleration-matched 01b M1 RAPTOR baseline (zero-velocity capture with intact memory; 01b: 86% of the N0 step, 93% of the altitude loss, 99% of the tilt). Part of it removed by T1 = (T0 - T1) / baseline, T0 and T1 from batch 01c (both N2 memory), 95% bootstrap over the three groups. In-batch T0 is compared with 01b M1 N2 (same profile and memory). Cross-batch reference as requested, not an acceptance splice.

scope: One frozen candidate, headless SITL only, x500, heading 0, each run its own Gazebo seed; n = 3 per group.
